4.title: 4. Shahar Chiqindi Logistikasi
4.desc: Cheklangan yoqilg'i, IoT sensorlar va tirbandlikni hisobga olib eng kam CO2 emissiyali optimal chiqindi marshrutini tanlang.

scenarios.title: Tirbandlik va Yoqilg'i Optimizatsiyasi
scenarios.param: Yoqilg'i: 20L | Masofa: 18 km | Chiqindi: 4.5t
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 50 65 L 180 30 L 320 30 L 450 65" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/><path d="M 50 65 L 250 100 L 450 65" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="50" cy="65" r="14" fill="#059669"/><text x="50" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Baza</text><circle cx="180" cy="30" r="12" fill="#10b981"/><text x="180" y="34" fill="#022c22" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Q1</text><circle cx="320" cy="30" r="12" fill="#10b981"/><text x="320" y="34" fill="#022c22" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Q2</text><circle cx="450" cy="65" r="14" fill="#3b82f6"/><text x="450" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Poligon</text><text x="250" y="20" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A-Smart: Aylanma halqa (12 km, 10L yoqilgi, 18 kg CO2)</text><text x="250" y="118" fill="#f87171" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B-Tirband: Markaziy svetoforlar (18 km, 22L yoqilgi - Yetmaydi!)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Ertalabki soat 08:30 da markaziy ko'chalarda tirbandlik. Bakda 20L dizel bor. Eng kam CO2 va xavfsiz marshrut qaysi?
options: Aylanma halqa yo'l (Smart): 12 km, barqaror tezlik, 10L yoqilg'i, 18 kg CO2 sarfi
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri markaziy ko'cha: 18 km, 1.5 soat tirbandlikda dvigatelni o't oldirib turish (22L yoqilg'i)
Chiqindilarni tashishni bekor qilib kechki 23:00 ga qoldirish
scenarios.hint: Tirbandlikda dvigatelning bo'sh ishlashi yoqilg'i sarfini va zaharli uglerod oksidini 3 barobargacha oshiradi.

scenarios.title: IoT Ultratovush Sensorlari Tahlili
scenarios.param: Sensorlar: A (95%), B (30%), C (100%), D (40%) to'lgan
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="40" y="30" width="70" height="70" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="75" y="65" fill="#f87171" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">95%</text><text x="75" y="85" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">A-Quti</text><rect x="160" y="30" width="70" height="70" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="195" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30%</text><text x="195" y="85" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">B-Quti</text><rect x="280" y="30" width="70" height="70" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="315" y="65" fill="#f87171" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">100%</text><text x="315" y="85" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">C-Quti</text><rect x="400" y="30" width="70" height="70" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="435" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">40%</text><text x="435" y="85" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">D-Quti</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Sensorlar ko'rsatkichi bo'yicha mashina faqat kritik to'lgan nuqtalarga borishi kerak. Qaysi harakat eng to'g'ri?
options: Faqat 95% va 100% to'lgan A va C nuqtalarga borish, chala to'lgan B va D ni keyingi smenaga qoldirish
To'lishidan qat'i nazar barcha 4 ta nuqtaga ketma-ket kirib chiqish
Faqat 30% to'lgan B konteynerga borib, qolganlarini kutish
scenarios.hint: Dinamik marshrutlash faqat 80% dan yuqori to'lgan qutilarni tanlash orqali logistika xarajatini 40% tejaydi.

scenarios.title: Chiqindini Qayta Yuklash Stansiyasi (Peregruzka)
scenarios.param: Poligongacha: 45 km | Qayta yuklash stansiyasigacha: 7 km
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="60" cy="65" r="25" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="60" y="70" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Kichik Mashina</text><line x1="90" y1="65" x2="220" y2="65" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="220" y="35" width="90" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="265" y="62" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Peregruzka</text><text x="265" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">K=1:6 Siqish</text><line x1="315" y1="65" x2="420" y2="65" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="445" cy="65" r="25" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="445" y="70" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Katta Fura (40t)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kichik 5 tonnalik mashinalar har safar 45 km uzoqdagi poligonga qatnashi texnikani toliqtirmoqda. Qaysi yechim optimal?
options: Shaharda 7 km masofada oraliq stansiya qurib, chiqindini 1:6 siqib 40 tonnalik yirik tirkamalarda tashish
Kichik mashinalarga qo'shimcha bak o'rnatib 45 km masofaga kuniga 8 martadan qatnash
Chiqindilarni tunda shahar chetiga vaqtincha to'kib qo'yish
scenarios.hint: Oraliq qayta yuklash stansiyalari shahar ichidagi kichik texnikalar yurish masofasini 70% ga qisqartiradi.

scenarios.title: Elektr Maxsus Texnika (EV Truck) Quvvati
scenarios.param: Batareya: 280 kVt*soat | Qolgan zaryad: 22% (60 kVt*soat)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="45" width="300" height="40" rx="10" fill="#020617" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="65" y="50" width="60" height="30" rx="6" fill="#f59e0b"/><text x="210" y="70" fill="white" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">22% Zaryad Qoldi</text><circle cx="430" cy="65" r="30" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="430" y="62" fill="#10b981" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">⚡</text><text x="430" y="78" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Tezkor Quvvat</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Gidravlik press har bir qutini ko'tarishda 3.5 kVt*soat sarflaydi. Mashinada 60 kVt*soat quvvat qoldi. To'g'ri qaror:
options: Keyingi 4 ta nuqtani yig'ib, 5 km masofadagi 150 kVt tezkor zaryadlash stansiyasiga yo'l olish
Zaryad nolga tushguncha qolgan barcha 18 ta qutini majburiy yig'ish
Gidravlik pressni o'chirib, chiqindilarni qo'lda qutiga bosish
scenarios.hint: Gidravlik presslash jarayoni elektr transport batareyasini harakatlanishdan 2 barobar tezroq sarflaydi.

scenarios.title: Ikki Seksiyali Chiqindi Mashinasi Balansi
scenarios.param: Seksiya A: Ho'l organik (4t) | Seksiya B: Quruq saralangan (2t)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="35" width="160" height="60" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="160" y="70" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ho'l Organik (4t)</text><rect x="250" y="35" width="160" height="60" rx="6" fill="#1e3a8a" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2"/><text x="330" y="70" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Quruq Qog'oz/Plastik (2t)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Aholi saralagan chiqindilarni bitta mashinada aralashtirmasdan olib ketish uchun qanday logistika texnologiyasi qo'llaniladi?
options: Ichki germetik to'siqli ikki kamerali (Dual-compartment) alohida gidravlik pressli mashina
Ikkala turdagi chiqindini bitta umumiy bunkerga tashlab, poligon ustida saralash
Avval qog'ozni yig'ib, keyin yana shu ko'chaga ikkinchi marta organikaga qaytib kelish
scenarios.hint: Ikki kamerali maxsus avtomobillar alohida yig'ish sifatini saqlagan holda logistika reyslarini 50% ga qisqartiradi.

scenarios.title: Tibbiyot Chiqindilari Logistikasi (ADR Xavfsizligi)
scenarios.param: Kategoriya: B va V sinf (Biologik xavfli buyumlar)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="70" y="35" width="90" height="60" rx="8" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="115" y="65" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">☣️</text><text x="115" y="82" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">B Sinf</text><line x1="170" y1="65" x2="310" y2="65" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/><rect x="320" y="30" width="120" height="70" rx="10" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="65" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Avtoklav / Insinerator</text><text x="380" y="82" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Termik Utilizatsiya</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Shifoxonalardan chiqqan patogen tibbiy chiqindilarni maishiy chiqindi poligoniga tashish mumkinmi?
options: Mutlaqo yo'q! Faqat maxsus sovutgichli, dezinfeksiyali furgonda insinerator yoki avtoklav zavodiga tashiladi
Ha, agar qalin qora paketlarga yaxshilab o'ralgan bo'lsa umumiy poligon chetiga ko'mish mumkin
Faqat tunda boshqa chiqindilarga aralashtirib olib ketishga ruxsat beriladi
scenarios.hint: SanQvaM 0317-15 bo'yicha tibbiy xavfli chiqindilar qat'iy ravishda termik zararsizlantirishga yo'naltirilishi shart.

scenarios.title: Shovqin Darajasi va Tungi Logistika
scenarios.param: SanQvaM me'yori: Tunda 40 dBA | Mashina shovqini: 78 dBA
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 50 80 Q 150 20 250 80 T 450 80" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="120" cy="55" r="16" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="120" y="60" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">78 dB</text><rect x="220" y="40" width="100" height="50" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="270" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Plastik Quti</text><text x="270" y="80" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle"><45 dB Akustik</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Aholi turar-joy massivlarida soat 23:00 dan keyin metall qutilarni shovqin bilan tushirish taqiqlangan. Tungi reysni qanday tashkil etish kerak?
options: G'ildirakli plastik yevro-konteynerlar va shovqinsiz elektr ko'targichli mashinalardan foydalanish
Shovqinni kamaytirish uchun chiqindilarni mashinaga balanddan uloqtirib bosish
Tungi yig'uvchilar signal chalg'ituvchi sirena bilan aholini ogohlantirishi lozim
scenarios.hint: Tungi shovqin me'yori oshishi fuqarolar salomatligi va sanitariya qoidalarining jiddiy buzilishi hisoblanadi.

scenarios.title: Chiqindini Siqish Koeffitsiyenti (Compaction)
scenarios.param: Boshlang'ich: 180 kg/m3 | Siqilgandan keyin: 720 kg/m3
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="35" width="140" height="60" rx="6" fill="#334155"/><text x="130" y="65" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">Siqilmagan (1:1)</text><text x="130" y="82" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">180 kg/m³</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="300" y="35" width="140" height="60" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="65" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Siqilgan (1:4)</text><text x="370" y="82" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">720 kg/m³</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindi tashuvchi avtomobilning gidravlik plitasi chiqindini 1:4 nisbatda siqadi. Bu logistikaga qanday ta'sir ko'rsatadi?
options: Mashina sig'imi 4 barobar oshadi va reyslar soni hamda yoqilg'i xarajati keskin kamayadi
Chiqindi siqilsa og'irligi 4 barobarga ko'payib ketadi va yo'l buziladi
Chiqindini siqish uning qayta ishlanishini butunlay imkonsiz qiladi
scenarios.hint: Yuqori siqish koeffitsiyenti avtopark amortizatsiyasi va transport tannarxini tejaydi.

scenarios.title: RFID Belgilash va Avtomatlashgan Tarozilar
scenarios.param: Konteyner: RFID Chip #8841 | Tarozilar: Avtomatik brutto/tara
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="80" cy="65" r="25" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="80" y="65" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">📡</text><text x="80" y="80" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">RFID</text><line x1="110" y1="65" x2="220" y2="65" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="220" y="40" width="160" height="50" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="300" y="65" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">GPS & Vzveshivaniye</text><text x="300" y="80" fill="#34d399" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Haqiqiy vazn: 342 kg</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chiqindi yig'ishda soxta hisobotlar (pripiska) va o'g'irliklarni yo'qotish uchun qanday texnologiya eng samarali?
options: Har bir konteynerga RFID chip va mashinaning ko'tarish manipulyatoriga avtomatik tarozi o'rnatish
Haydovchiga har bir qutini ko'z bilan chamalab daftarga yozib borishni buyurish
Faqat poligon darvozasidagi qo'lda yoziladigan qog'oz jurnalga tayanish
scenarios.hint: RFID va telematika tizimi qaysi mahalladan qancha chiqindi olinganini millisekundlarda markaziy serverga jo'natadi.

scenarios.title: Tog'li Hududlarda Qishki Ekologik Logistika
scenarios.param: Nishablik: 14% | Muzlama | Yozgi shinalar taqiqlangan
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 50 100 L 250 40 L 450 100" fill="none" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="250" cy="40" r="14" fill="#1e3a8a" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="44" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Tog' Qishlog'i</text><rect x="180" y="80" width="140" height="35" rx="6" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="250" y="102" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4x4 To'liq Privod + Zanjir</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Chorvoq yoki Bo'stonliq tog'li hududlarida qishda yo'llar muzlaganda chiqindi tashish qanday tashkil etiladi?
options: Kichik 4x4 to'liq yetakchi zanjirli mashinalar bilan oraliq xabga tushirilib, keyin yirik texnikaga yuklanadi
Qish tugaguncha tog' qishloqlariga chiqindi mashinasi yuborishni butunlay to'xtatish
20 tonnalik og'ir tirkamalarni muzlagan tog' dovoniga zanjirsiz haydash
scenarios.hint: Tog'li hududlarda xavfsizlik va barqaror sanitar tozalik uchun maxsus kichik gabaritli 4x4 texnikalar qo'llaniladi.

5.title: 5. Daryo Tozalash & Neft To'kilishi
5.desc: Daryoga to'kilgan neft dog'ini bon to'siqlar, gidravlik skimmerlar va biologik sorbentlar bilan tezkor lokallashtiring.

scenarios.title: Daryo Oqimi va Bon To'siqlari Burchagi
scenarios.param: Oqim tezligi: 0.9 m/s | To'kilgan neft: 12 tonna
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 0 40 Q 250 20 500 40 L 500 110 Q 250 90 0 110 Z" fill="#0f172a"/><path d="M 120 45 L 360 85" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="10,4"/><text x="240" y="60" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">Bon to'sig'i (45° burchak ostida)</text><circle cx="200" cy="50" r="10" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="200" y="54" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Neft</text><text x="400" y="95" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10">Skimmer tomon oqim</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Oqim tezligi 0.9 m/s bo'lgan daryoda bon to'sig'i to'g'ri 90° burchakda o'rnatilsa nima yuz beradi?
options: Kuchli gidrodinamik bosim tufayli neft bon tagidan o'tib ketadi (entrainment); bon 40-45° qiya o'rnatilishi shart
Neft butunlay to'xtaydi va darhol suv tubiga cho'kadi
Bon to'sig'i erib suvga aralashib ketadi
scenarios.hint: Tez oqimlarda bonlar 40-45° burchak ostida yo'naltiruvchi tarzda qo'yilib, neft qirg'oqdagi tinch cho'ntakka yig'iladi.

scenarios.title: Gidravlik Diskli Skimmer Tanlash
scenarios.param: Neft plyonkasi: 4 mm | Qovushqoqlik: O'rtacha
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="10" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="215" cy="65" r="20" fill="#0284c7"/><circle cx="285" cy="65" r="20" fill="#0284c7"/><text x="250" y="45" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Oleofil Diskli Skimmer</text><text x="250" y="90" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">98% Toza Neft Yig'ish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Suv aralashmasisiz toza neftni so'rib olish uchun qaysi turdagi skimmer apparati tanlanadi?
options: Oleofil (neftni o'ziga yopishtiruvchi, suvni itaruvchi) diskli yoki barabanli skimmer
Oddiy loyqa so'ruvchi qum nasosi (drakor)
Suv yuzasiga qizdirilgan havo purkagich
scenarios.hint: Oleofil polimer disklar neftni 98% toza holda yig'ib oladi va suvni qaytarib chiqaradi.

scenarios.title: Biologik Torf Sorbentlari (Bio-sorb)
scenarios.param: Qoldiq yupqa neft plyonkasi: 0.1 mm sheen
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><ellipse cx="250" cy="65" rx="180" ry="35" fill="#0c4a6e"/><circle cx="210" cy="65" r="8" fill="#10b981"/><circle cx="250" cy="60" r="8" fill="#10b981"/><circle cx="290" cy="70" r="8" fill="#10b981"/><text x="250" y="115" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hidrofob Tabiiy Torf Sorbenti</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Skimmer yig'a olmaydigan o'ta yupqa kamalaksimon neft plyonkasini tozalashda qaysi material qo'llaniladi?
options: Suvni shimib olmaydigan, faqat neftni yutuvchi tabiiy gidrofob torf yoki yog'och tolali sorbent
Qurilish sementi yoki ohak kukuni
Daryoga ko'p miqdorda idish yuvish geli quyish
scenarios.hint: Gidrofob bio-sorbentlar o'z og'irligidan 8-10 barobar ko'p neftni bir necha daqiqada shimib oladi.

scenarios.title: Ichimlik Suvi Vodozaborini Himoyalash
scenarios.param: Vodozaborgacha masofa: 3.5 km | Oqim vaqti: 40 daqiqa
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="40" y="45" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#7f1d1d"/><text x="80" y="68" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Avariya Joyi</text><line x1="130" y1="65" x2="350" y2="65" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8,4"/><rect x="360" y="35" width="110" height="60" rx="8" fill="#1e3a8a" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/><text x="415" y="60" fill="white" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Shahar Vodozabor</text><text x="415" y="78" fill="#f87171" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Zudlik bilan to'xtatish!</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Neft dog'i shahar ichimlik suvi olish inshooti tomon harakatlanmoqda. Zudlik bilan qanday harakat qilinadi?
options: Vodozabor shlyuzlarini darhol yopish, zaxira yerosti suviga o'tish va suv olish oldiga 3 qator bon o'rnatish
Vodozabor nasoslarini maksimal quvvatda ishlatib neftni shahar quvurlariga tortib yuborish
Neft o'tib ketishini kutib turish
scenarios.hint: Ichimlik suviga neft mahsulotlarining 0.05 mg/l dan ortiq tushishi butun shahar tarmog'ini zaharlaydi.

scenarios.title: Neft Yutuvchi Bakteriyalar (Bioremediatsiya)
scenarios.param: Tuproq va daryo qirg'og'i ifloslanishi: 15 g/kg neft
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="80" y="40" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="140" y="65" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Neft Uglevodorodlari</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">→</text><rect x="300" y="40" width="140" height="50" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="62" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pseudomonas Shtammi</text><text x="370" y="78" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">CO2 + H2O ga parchalash</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qirg'oq zonasidagi qoldiq neft dog'larini xavfsiz yo'qotish uchun qaysi zamonaviy biometod ishlatiladi?
options: Neft uglevodorodlarini yeyuvchi tabiiy mikroorganizmlar biopreparati (Rhodococcus, Pseudomonas) va azotli oziqlantirish
Qirg'oq bo'yini benzin sepib yoqib yuborish
Qirg'oqni xlorli eritma bilan dezinfeksiya qilish
scenarios.hint: Bioremediatsiya bakteriyalari neftni xavfsiz suv va karbonat angidridga aylantirib, ekotizimni tiklaydi.

scenarios.title: Kimyoviy Dispersantlar Xavfi
scenarios.param: Daryo ekotizimi: Baliqlar uvildiriqlashi davri
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="24" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="150" y="62" fill="white" font-size="18">⚠️</text><text x="150" y="80" fill="#fca5a5" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">Dispersant</text><text x="320" y="65" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Chuchuk suv daryolarida dispersant taqiqlanadi!</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Nima sababdan chuchuk suv daryolarida neftni maydalovchi kimyoviy dispersantlar qo'llanilishi taqiqlanadi?
options: Dispersant neftni yo'qotmaydi, balki zaharli mikro-tomchilarga aylantirib suv tubidagi baliq va planktonlarni o'ldiradi
Chunki dispersant suvni qattiq muzlatib qo'yadi
Chunki u daryo rangini o'zgartirib yuboradi
scenarios.hint: Kimyoviy dispersantlar dengizda ishlatilishi mumkin, ammo ichimlik va baliqchilik daryolarida o'ta xavfli toksik hisoblanadi.

scenarios.title: Muz Ostidagi Neft Qatlami
scenarios.param: Daryo yuzi muzlagan (muz qalinligi 25 sm)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="50" y="30" width="400" height="25" fill="#93c5fd"/><text x="250" y="47" fill="#1e3a8a" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Muz Qatlami (25 sm)</text><rect x="50" y="55" width="280" height="15" fill="#000000"/><text x="190" y="67" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Muz ostidagi neft oqimi</text><rect x="360" y="30" width="60" height="55" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="390" y="65" fill="white" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">O'yilgan Tirqish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qishda muz ostida oqayotgan neftni qanday tutib qolish mumkin?
options: Muzni zanjirli arra bilan o'yib tirqishlar (mayna) ochish va suv tubiga tushuvchi to'siqlar bilan neftni o'yiqqa to'plash
Muz eriguncha bahorgacha hech qanday chora ko'rmaslik
Daryoning butun muzini dinamit bilan portlatish
scenarios.hint: Muz osti neft oqimi muz o'yiqlarida to'planadi va vakuumli nasoslar yordamida so'rib olinadi.

scenarios.title: Daryo Tubiga Cho'kkan Neft Shlami
scenarios.param: Og'ir mazut suv tubiga cho'kkan (suv harorati 4°C)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 50 100 L 450 100" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="8"/><text x="250" y="120" fill="#d97706" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Daryo tubi loyqasi va cho'kkan og'ir mazut</text><rect x="200" y="45" width="100" height="45" rx="6" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="70" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Gidravlik Ejektor</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Daryo tubiga o'tirib qolgan og'ir uglevodorodlarni loyqa ko'tarmasdan qanday yig'ish kerak?
options: Past turbulentlikka ega g'avvos boshqaruvidagi vakuumli ejektor apparati bilan so'rib olish
Ekskavator cho'michi bilan daryo tubini qazib loyqani suvga yoyish
Daryo tubiga qum to'kib neftni ustidan bostirib qo'yish
scenarios.hint: Noto'g'ri qazish neftni daryo bo'ylab oqizib, o'nlab kilometr pastdagi faunani zaharlaydi.

scenarios.title: Uchuvchan Uglevodorodlar (BTEX) Bug'lanishi
scenarios.param: Benzol, toluol va ksilol havoga bug'lanmoqda
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><path d="M 150 70 Q 180 30 210 70 T 270 70 T 330 70" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/><text x="250" y="30" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Toksik Uchuvchan Bug'lar (Portlash xavfi!)</text><circle cx="250" cy="85" r="25" fill="#7f1d1d"/><text x="250" y="90" fill="white" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">🔥</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Yengil neft to'kilganda daryo yuzasida kuchli zaharli bug' va portlash xavfi bor. Qutqaruvchilar nima qilishi kerak?
options: Suv yuzasiga bug'lanishni to'suvchi ko'pik (AFFF) sepish va barcha ochiq olov manbalarini o'chirish
Daryo qirg'og'ida olov yoqib bug'larni tekshirish
Ventilyatorlar bilan bug'ni yaqin qishloq tomonga haydash
scenarios.hint: Ko'pikli qatlam uchuvchan zaharli gazlarning havoga ko'tarilishini to'xtatib, yong'in xavfini bartaraf etadi.

scenarios.title: Baliqchilik Xo'jaligini Muhofaza Qilish
scenarios.param: To'kilgan joydan 1.2 km quyida sun'iy baliq hovuzlari
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="340" y="30" width="120" height="70" rx="8" fill="#047857" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="400" y="60" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Baliq Zavodi</text><text x="400" y="78" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Suv Kirish Shlyuzi</text><line x1="280" y1="20" x2="300" y2="110" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4"/><text x="250" y="65" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">Himoya To'sig'i</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Baliq chavoqlari yetishtiriladigan havzalarga neftli suv kirmasligi uchun:
options: Kanal kirish shlyuzini to'liq berkitib, daryo bo'ylab qo'shimcha pnevmatik havo pardasi (Bubble curtain) qo'yish
Baliqlarga ko'proq ozuqa berib neftdan himoya qilish
Hovuzga xlor sepib neftni zararsizlantirish
scenarios.hint: Pnevmatik havo pardalari (Bubble curtain) kemalar qatnoviga xalaqit bermasdan neft plyonkasini to'liq qaytaradi.

6.title: 6. Biogaz Reaktorini Sozlash
6.desc: Reaktordagi harorat (37°C), pH (7.2) va organikani rostlab, elektr energiyasi hosil qiling.

scenarios.title: Mezofil Rejim Haroratini Barqarorlashtirish
scenarios.param: Joriy harorat: 31°C (Kritik tushish) | Maqsad: 37°C ± 1°C
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="10" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#f87171" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">31°C</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Metanogenez susaygan</text><path d="M 80 65 L 170 65" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3"/><text x="125" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Issiq Suv Ko'ylagi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qishda bioreaktorda harorat 31°C ga tushib ketdi. Metan hosil bo'lishi 70% ga pasaydi. Operator qanday chora ko'radi?
options: Reaktor tashqi isitish ko'ylagiga (rubashka) issiq suv aylanmasini oshirib, haroratni silliq 37°C ga ko'tarish
Reaktor ichiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaynoq suv quyib zudlik bilan 60°C ga chiqarish
Isitishni o'chirib, bakteriyalar sovuqqa moslashishini kutish
scenarios.hint: Mezofil metanogen bakteriyalar haroratning 1-2°C dan keskin sakrashiga o'ta sezgir, asta-sekin isitish zarur.

scenarios.title: Reaktor Kislotaliligi (pH Balansi va Zakisleniye)
scenarios.param: Joriy pH: 6.1 (Kislotali xavf) | Norma: 6.8 - 7.4
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="60" y="45" width="380" height="35" rx="6" fill="#1e293b"/><rect x="60" y="45" width="120" height="35" rx="6" fill="#ef4444"/><text x="120" y="68" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">pH 6.1 Kislotali</text><rect x="230" y="45" width="120" height="35" rx="6" fill="#10b981"/><text x="290" y="68" fill="#022c22" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">pH 7.2 Optimal</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Ortiqcha shakar va xamir qoldiqlari solinishi natijasida pH 6.1 ga tushib, 'achish' (zakisleniye) boshlandi. Qanday qutqariladi?
options: Yangi organik xomashyo yuklashni to'xtatish va bufer sifatida so'ndirilgan ohak yoki soda eritmasi qo'shish
Reaktorga ko'proq nordon sut va sirka quyish
Reaktor qopqog'ini ochib havo kiritish
scenarios.hint: pH 6.5 dan tushganda metanogen bakteriyalar nobud bo'ladi, zudlik bilan ishqoriy bufer (Ca(OH)2) kiritish lozim.

scenarios.title: Biogaz Tarkibidagi Metan (CH4) Foizi
scenarios.param: Metan: 65% | Karbonat angidrid: 33% | H2S: 2%
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="150" cy="65" r="40" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="150" y="60" fill="#34d399" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">65% CH4</text><text x="150" y="80" fill="white" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Yuqori Kaloriya</text><circle cx="320" cy="65" r="30" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="320" y="68" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">33% CO2</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Biogaz kogeneratsiya generatorida yonishi uchun uning tarkibidagi metan (CH4) miqdori kamida qancha bo'lishi kerak?
options: Kamida 50-55% metan (optimal 60-65%), aks holda gaz dvigatelida yonish sodir bo'lmaydi
10% metan bo'lsa ham dvigatel to'liq quvvatda ishlayveradi
Biogazda metan bo'lishi shart emas, faqat CO2 yonsa kifoya
scenarios.hint: Metan miqdori 50% dan past bo'lsa, gaz alangalanmaydi va generator avariya holatida o'chadi.

scenarios.title: Vodorod Sulfid (H2S) Gazini Tozalash
scenarios.param: H2S darajasi: 2400 ppm (dvigatelni zanglatadi)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Desulfurizatsiya Kolonnasi</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Fe2O3 Granulalari (<50 ppm)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Biogazdagi oltingugurt (H2S) dvigatel silindrlarini zanglatib ishdan chiqaradi. Uni qanday tozalash kerak?
options: Biogazni temir oksidi (Fe2O3) granulali filtri yoki biologik skrubber orqali o'tkazib H2S ni 50 ppm dan pastga tushirish
Biogazga xom suv purkash
Gazni tozalash shart emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri generatorga berish
scenarios.hint: H2S yonish kamerasida suv bug'i bilan birikib oltingugurt kislotasiga aylanadi va metallni yemirib yuboradi.

scenarios.title: Ko-substrat: Qoramol Go'ngi va Oziq-ovqat
scenarios.param: Nisbat: 70% go'ng (bufer) + 30% oshxona organikasi (energiya)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="70" y="40" width="140" height="50" rx="6" fill="#78350f"/><text x="140" y="68" fill="#fcd34d" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Go'ng (Barqaror Mikroflora)</text><text x="240" y="70" fill="#10b981" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+</text><rect x="270" y="40" width="160" height="50" rx="6" fill="#047857"/><text x="350" y="68" fill="#a7f3d0" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Oshxona Chiqindisi (Yuqori Gaz)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Nega sof oshxona chiqindisiga nisbatan unga go'ng qo'shib achitish (ko-fermentatsiya) ancha barqaror?
options: Go'ng reaktorga zarur metanogen bakteriyalar va ammoniy buferini beradi, kislotalilik buzilishini oldini oladi
Chunki go'ng gaz hosil bo'lishini to'xtatadi
Chunki go'ng hidni yo'qotadi
scenarios.hint: Ko-fermentatsiya (Co-digestion) jarayoni biogaz unumdorligini sof substratga nisbatan 2.5 barobar oshiradi.

scenarios.title: Reaktor Aralashtirgichi (Mixer) Rejimi
scenarios.param: Qatlamlanish: Ustki qattiq qobiq (korka) va cho'kindi
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="40" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M 230 65 L 270 65 M 250 45 L 250 85" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="3"/><text x="250" y="120" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Daqiqasiga 15 daqiqa sekin aylantirish</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Bioreaktor ichidagi mexanik aralashtirgich uzluksiz 24 soat maksimal tezlikda aylanishi kerakmi?
options: Yo'q! Uzluksiz tez aylanish bakteriyalar koloniyalarini uzib yuboradi; har soatda 10-15 daqiqa sekin aylantirish kifoya
Ha, aralashtirgich motorini hech qachon to'xtatmaslik kerak
Aralashtirgichni umuman ishlatmaslik kerak
scenarios.hint: Davriy sekin aralashtirish qobiq hosil bo'lishini to'xtatadi va mikroorganizmlar uchun tinch muhit beradi.

scenarios.title: Organik Quruq Modda (ODM) Suyultirish
scenarios.param: Quruq modda: 22% (Juda quyuq) | Maqsad: 9-11% ODM
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="100" y="40" width="120" height="50" rx="6" fill="#334155"/><text x="160" y="70" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">22% ODM (Quyuq loy)</text><text x="250" y="70" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+ H2O</text><rect x="290" y="40" width="130" height="50" rx="6" fill="#065f46" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="355" y="70" fill="#34d399" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">10% ODM (Suyuq oquvchan)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Qoramol go'ngi juda quruq bo'lsa, nasoslar tiqilib qoladi. Qanday suyultiriladi?
options: Reaktordan chiqqan suyuq fraksiya (fugat) yoki texnik suv bilan 1:1 aralashtirib 10% gacha suyultirish
Sho'r dengiz suvi quyish
Hech narsa qo'shmasdan nasosni zo'riqtirib haydash
scenarios.hint: 10% quruq modda gidravlik aylanish va bakteriyalarning substrat bilan aloqasi uchun ideal konsistensiya hisoblanadi.

scenarios.title: VFA/TIC Indeksi Tahlili
scenarios.param: VFA/TIC nisbati: 0.28 (Barqaror zona)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="120" y="35" width="260" height="60" rx="8" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="60" fill="#10b981" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">VFA/TIC = 0.28</text><text x="250" y="80" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Kislotalar va Buferning Zo'r Balansi</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Laboratoriya tahlilida VFA/TIC koeffitsiyenti 0.45 dan oshib ketdi. Bu nimani anglatadi?
options: Reaktorga me'yordan ortiq oziqa yuklangan va kislotali buzilish xavfi bor; yuklashni zudlik bilan kamaytirish kerak
Reaktorda metan hosil bo'lishi 100% ga yetganini anglatadi
Bakteriyalar och qolganini va zudlik bilan 10 barobar ko'p oziqa solish kerakligini bildiradi
scenarios.hint: VFA/TIC > 0.4 bo'lishi reaktorning 'qorin to'yishi' (overload) va kislotali krizis arafasida ekanligini ko'rsatadi.

scenarios.title: Bio-o'g'it (Digestate) Separatsiyasi
scenarios.param: Chiqayotgan massa: Suyuq va qattiq fraksiya
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="180" y="30" width="140" height="70" rx="8" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="55" fill="#34d399" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Shnekli Separator</text><text x="250" y="75" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Qattiq (gumus) + Suyuq (N-P-K)</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Biogaz chiqqandan keyin qolgan qoldiq (efflyuent) qanday qimmatbaho mahsulotga aylanadi?
options: Shnekli separator orqali qattiq bio-gumus (organik o'g'it) va suyuq azotli bio-o'g'itga ajratiladi
Zaharli chiqindi sifatida poligon chuquriga ko'miladi
Kanalizatsiyaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oqizib yuboriladi
scenarios.hint: Fermentatsiyalangan bio-o'g'it tarkibida begona o't urug'lari va gelmint tuxumlari bo'lmaydi, eng toza organik o'g'itdir.

scenarios.title: Avariya Mash'alasi (Gas Flare) va Bosim
scenarios.param: Gazgolder bosimi: 45 mbar (Maksimal ruxsat: 50 mbar)
scenarios.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 500 130" class="w-full h-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800"><rect x="120" y="45" width="160" height="40" rx="6" fill="#1e293b"/><text x="200" y="70" fill="#f87171" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Bosim: 45 mbar ⚠️</text><circle cx="380" cy="65" r="25" fill="#7f1d1d" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/><text x="380" y="70" fill="white" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">🔥 Flare</text></svg>
scenarios.question: Kogenerator to'xtab qolganda gazgolderda metan bosimi kritik darajaga yetdi. Avtomatik tizim nima qiladi?
options: Gidrozatvor klapanini ochib, ortiqcha biogazni xavfsiz avariya mash'alasi (flare)da yoqib yuboradi
Biogazni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri atmosferaga purkab yuboradi
Reaktor qopqog'ini portlatadi
scenarios.hint: Metanni atmosferaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqarish CO2 dan 28 barobar kuchli issiqxona effekti beradi, shuning uchun mash'alada yoqiladi.
